pages.text: $(thing)Wild Tobacco$() is the natural starting point. Flowering wild tobacco can appear in Forest, Birch Forest, and Dark Forest. Breaking it can provide wild leaf and seeds.

The other varieties are most reliably obtained from a $(thing)Tobacconist Master$() villager. A Hookah is that profession's workstation. Place a Hookah where an unemployed villager can claim it, just as you would place a normal villager workstation.
pages.title: Tobacconist Master

pages.text: At novice level, the Tobacconist Master can offer $(item)Wild, Virginia, Burley, Oriental, Dokha, and Shade seeds$(). Each seed trade costs 1 Emerald; availability is still subject to the villager's normal trade list and stock.
pages.title: Seed Trades
